description.p: The easiest way to mod Sonic Adventure DX and Sonic Adventure 2 on Linux. Finds your Steam installs, downloads community mods, and handles mod managers, runtimes, resolution, load order, and language settings so you can play right away.
LinuxでSonic Adventure DXとSonic Adventure 2にModを入れるいちばん簡単な方法です。Steamのインストールを見つけ、コミュニティのModをダウンロードし、Modマネージャー、ランタイム、解像度、読み込み順、言語の設定まで済ませるので、すぐに遊べます。

Il modo più semplice per moddare Sonic Adventure DX e Sonic Adventure 2 su Linux. Trova le tue installazioni di Steam, scarica i mod della community e si occupa di gestori dei mod, runtime, risoluzione, ordine di caricamento e lingue, così puoi giocare subito.

La façon la plus simple de modder Sonic Adventure DX et Sonic Adventure 2 sous Linux. Trouve vos installations Steam, télécharge des mods de la communauté et s’occupe des gestionnaires de mods, des runtimes, de la résolution, de l’ordre de chargement et des langues pour que vous puissiez jouer tout de suite.

La forma más fácil de usar mods en Sonic Adventure DX y Sonic Adventure 2 en Linux. Encuentra tus instalaciones de Steam, descarga mods de la comunidad y se encarga de los gestores de mods, los runtimes, la resolución, el orden de carga y los idiomas, así podés jugar enseguida.

Der einfachste Weg, Sonic Adventure DX und Sonic Adventure 2 unter Linux zu modden. Findet deine Steam-Installationen, lädt Community-Mods herunter und kümmert sich um Mod-Manager, Runtimes, Auflösung, Ladereihenfolge und Spracheinstellungen, damit du sofort loslegen kannst.

description.p: The AppImage opens its window on systems without some X11 keyboard and cursor libraries, such as a minimal Ubuntu 22.04.
The AppImage now starts on older systems, such as Ubuntu 22.04.
Games Steam moved to another library are found again.

ul.li: Games are found from Steam's own install records, even when its library list is out of date
A library that was deleted no longer asks for Grant Access when the game is installed elsewhere
An empty NO_COLOR setting no longer turns off colors in the terminal

description.p: GE-Proton and other custom Proton builds are recognized.

ul.li: GE-Proton 10 is detected as Proton 10, and Proton 11 builds such as GE-Proton 11 are caught before setup
Proton is found in every Steam library and tool folder, so a leftover copy no longer asks you to launch the game again and again
Messages name the Proton build, such as Proton 10.0 or GE-Proton10-34
The detect command shows each game's Proton status

description.p: The Snap can get into your Steam folders without a terminal.

ul.li: When the Snap can't open your Steam folder, Grant Access opens the file chooser right there
Games in your other Steam libraries show up once the Steam folder is granted

description.p: The Snap asks for less access to your Steam folders and tells you what it's missing.

ul.li: The Snap can only change the two games' folders and their Proton prefixes
When the Snap can't open your Steam folder, it shows the command that fixes it, with a Copy button
A library the Snap can't change shows Grant Access, instead of failing partway through setup
Libraries picked in the file chooser show their real folder
Long install paths no longer run over the Installation title

description.p: The app now remembers your window size and the mods you picked.

ul.li: The window opens at the size you left it, on Wayland too
Setup starts with the preset or mods you picked last time for each game

description.p: Mod downloads no longer crawl when GameBanana sends them to a slow mirror.

ul.li: A download that stays very slow for 20 seconds asks GameBanana for another mirror and keeps what it already has, up to three times
The log no longer repeats the detected screen resolution on every frame

description.p: Setting up .NET no longer runs anything through Proton, and the Flatpak and Snap need less access to your system.

ul.li: .NET is unpacked straight into the game's Proton prefix instead of running Microsoft's installers
The Flatpak can no longer run programs outside its sandbox
Every package builds 7-Zip and HDiffPatch from source
The AppImage now runs on older distros, like Ubuntu 24.04, Debian 13 and Fedora 42
The Snap now runs in Snap's sandbox instead of with full access to your system
Snap users: after installing, run the snap connect commands from the README so it can reach Steam, your drives and controllers

description.p: Mod downloads no longer hang when a server stops responding.

ul.li: A download that gets no data for 30 seconds stops and tries again, up to three times
The install screen shows which mod is downloading, how much is done, and when it is waiting for the server or retrying
Cancel now stops a stuck download right away

description.p: Fixes a crash when reading some Steam library files.

ul.li: Steam library files with a backslash before an accented or other non-English character no longer crash game detection

description.p: Adventure Mods now speaks Spanish, French, German, Italian, and Japanese, and the mod lists got an update.

ul.li: The app follows your system language
Every screen, message, and mod description is translated, and so is the command line
Sizes and decimals are written the way your language writes them
Japanese text has its own font, so it never shows as boxes
7 new mods: 4 for SA2 and 3 for SADX
HUD Plus and Cutscene Revamp Extensions start with their best options on
SA2 Render Fix loads first, so it no longer warns at startup
Multiplayer and the SA2 retranslations load where their pages ask
ADX Audio and 16:9 Flashbacks are gone: the Steam copy doesn't need the first, and Dreamcast Conversion overrides the second
Every mod has a plainer description

description.p: The app opens faster, and screenshots and covers show up right away.

ul.li: The Flatpak is now an optimized build, so the whole app opens and runs faster
Mod screenshots load ahead of time, so hovering a mod or turning a page shows them instantly
Game covers appear on the first frame
The page arrows no longer miss a click while a screenshot loads

description.p: Fixes the mod preview ignoring the mouse.

ul.li: Hovering a mod now previews it right away, without clicking somewhere else first

description.p: The app now fits every screen size.

ul.li: Scaled the whole app with the window, so it fits small windows and fills big screens
Opened the first window sized for the screen
Kept the mod preview picture from pushing its description off screen
Added "Made with ❤ by astro" to About

description.p: Fixes controller hints showing up without a controller.

ul.li: Stopped treating some virtual mice as controllers in the Flatpak

description.p: Fixes a missing arrow in setup instructions.

ul.li: Showed the arrow in "Properties → Compatibility" instead of a box
Updated the screenshots to the new look

description.p: A new interface made for the couch: it works with a controller and fits the Steam Deck.

ul.li: Moved from GTK to egui, with large text and buttons and a clear focus ring
Added controller support: the D-pad or stick moves, A selects, B goes back, Start continues
Opened fullscreen in Steam's Game Mode
Added smooth animations and a cleaner, centered layout
Moved the Flatpak to the smaller Freedesktop runtime
Added a Snap package to each release
Kept settings and granted Steam libraries from earlier versions

description.p: A new app icon, plus updated dependencies.

ul.li: Redesigned the app icon
Updated the bundled 7-Zip to 26.04

description.p: The first stable release. Every part of the app and the command line is now covered by automated tests.
Redesigned setup, and added restoring the original game, mod updates and resumable downloads.

ul.li: Made every choice up front, then installed everything in one step with a live checklist
Showed on each game whether its mods are installed, with Change Mods and Restore
Added Restore to undo setup, keeping downloaded mods for later
Installed .NET Desktop Runtime 8 next to 10: SA Mod Manager 1.3.7 needs 8 to start and warns until 10 is installed
Updated installed mods when a newer file is available, keeping their settings
Resumed interrupted downloads instead of starting over
Showed the total download size while choosing mods
Kept the mod list responsive while screenshots load
Used Steam libraries granted in the app from the command line too
Explained when a game is in a Steam library that cannot be accessed
Moved the Flatpak to the GNOME 51 runtime

description.p: Updated release downloads to include the version in every AppImage and Flatpak filename.
Updated application and packaging dependencies.
Improved Steam library access and Proton detection in Flatpak.

ul.li: Refreshed detected games automatically after granting Steam library access
Resolved Proton installations stored outside the sandbox through the document portal
Validated that granted paths match the requested Steam library
Ran .NET dependency installers through Proton's prefix launcher and compatible Wine runtime

description.p: Improved Proton compatibility checks before setup begins.

ul.li: Detected configured Proton 11+ tools before Steam replaces a working Proton 10 prefix
Prevented setup from continuing until the game's Proton configuration is ready
Added a Check Again action to refresh the configuration without starting installation

description.p: Improved animation smoothness and interface responsiveness.

ul.li: Coalesced progress display updates to keep animations responsive
Cached and reused mod preview images while avoiding redundant refreshes
Added quick fade-in step transitions with reduced-motion support

description.p: Updated runtime requirements for the latest SA Mod Manager.

ul.li: Installed .NET Desktop Runtime 10 instead of 8
Detected runtime major version 10 or newer so existing 8.x prefixes are upgraded
Detected Proton 11+ prefixes and guided users to force Proton 10.0

description.p: Improved Linux packaging and Flatpak distribution.

ul.li: Added production Flatpak builds for x86_64 and ARM64
Prepared publication through the official astrovm Flatpak repository
Updated Flatpak and AppImage dependencies, validation, and host integration

description.p: Added ARM64 packaging support and refreshed CI builds.

ul.li: Added x86_64 and ARM64 AppImage release builds
Added architecture-specific Flatpak helper binaries for 7-Zip and hpatchz
Updated GitHub Actions builds to Ubuntu 26.04 runners

description.p: Improved graphical setup crash resilience.

ul.li: Prevented Rust panics in GTK callbacks from aborting the application
Handled stale setup navigation state with retryable errors instead of crashes

description.p: Improved setup reliability, mod selection polish, and maintainability.

ul.li: Unified CLI and graphical setup workflows for consistent installation behavior
Improved Proton discovery performance
Stabilized mod selection column widths when preview content changes
Updated Rust dependencies, including GTK bindings and download stack support
Simplified setup code and test organization for easier maintenance

description.p: AppImage compatibility and auto-update support.

ul.li: Bundled libxml2 in the AppImage for compatibility with distributions shipping libxml2 2.15+
Added AppImage auto-updates via zsync
Paths in the UI and CLI now abbreviate the home directory as ~

description.p: CLI setup now prompts for language and detects physical resolution.

ul.li: Interactive CLI setup prompts for subtitle and voice language like the GUI does
Resolution detection uses physical pixel dimensions accounting for fractional scaling

description.p: Faster, more reliable mod setup.

ul.li: Downloads and installs selected mods concurrently during setup
Resolves the latest GameBanana downloads at install time
Downloads SA2 Render Fix directly from its GitHub releases page

description.p: Improved progress reporting in both the GUI and CLI.

ul.li: GUI progress bars now show meaningful status labels during all download steps
Per-mod byte-level download progress shown in both GUI and CLI
CLI displays live MB counter for convert and mod manager download steps

description.p: Removed status messages shown after game detection.
Added a full command-line workflow for setup and detection, plus manual language selection during setup.

ul.li: Added detect command to show supported game installs and inaccessible Steam libraries
Added list-mods command to show presets and recommended mods by game
Added setup command for headless installation and config generation
Added subtitle and voice language selection for SADX and SA2 setup
Saved language selections per game so rerunning setup reuses the last choice

description.p: Improved setup reliability and Steam integration.

ul.li: Replaced protontricks-based setup with direct Proton integration
Expanded Steam library detection
Improved the welcome page and setup flow
Fixed packaged archive extraction

description.p: First release.

ul.li: Full mod setup for Sonic Adventure DX and Sonic Adventure 2
Steam install detection
Mod preset support
Mod manager installation
.NET runtime setup through protontricks
